title: Harry Edison joins after Lucky Millinder's trumpets cut the band
summary: Lucky Millinder's band with three strong trumpets crushed Basie in Baltimore, so Basie reworked the trumpet section and hired Harry Edison.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Now when does Harry Edison come in the band?
Well, whose place did he take?

Well Harry took, it must have been that place. No, you know that's kind of hard for me to remember because Shad Collins was in the band. We went through a lot of trumpet players. Shad Collins was one, he may, not he didn't, he didn't take Shad's place. They were in there together. It might have been Todd's, Tuddy's place.
Now, where did he come from?
He's from Kentucky, born down there. But he was playing with Lucky Millinder.
You see, Lucky Millinder had a band and he had Bama.
Yes. Carl Warwick. He had Charlie Shavers.
And Harry Edison. Three good trumpets. And we played a battle of music against Lucky Millinder and they just, they just crucified us. (LAUGHTER).
In Baltimore. Oh, they did everything to us you see. They cut us. And you
know, sometimes you just can't get started. And they were in good shape. Maybe it was because they knew that they were running up against Basie. And we thought, we'd took them lightly.
This was at the time they, didn't they have Tab Smith and Billy Kyle?
Well, I mean, that was a pretty good band.

Well they sure beat us. So right away Basie was trying to get, he had been trying to get Dizzy and Dizzy wasn't playing like he plays now. He just left........(voice fades out). But Dizzy wouldn't come.
So Basie set out to break up this trumpet section. And he did. (He cut this section?) and he cut us. So we got Harry, he came on in.
